newsitem.title: USA: US spot jet fuel rises with NYMEX heat, diffs ease.
newsitem.headline: US spot jet fuel rises with NYMEX heat, diffs ease.

text.p: U.S. spot jet fuel prices jumped by more than one cent a gallon this afternoon in line with weaker NYMEX heating oil values, industry sources said.
But the cash market gains lagged futures somewhat due to weaker differentials at both centers as excitement surrounding military action near iraq.

The activity there, which consisted of the U.S. firing dozens of missiles at iraqi defense targets appears to have subsided. In addition, the U.S. has said that it does not plan to tender for jet fuel barrels as a result of the action.
In the Gulf Coast, aviation-quality 54-grade fuel traded at 1.25 cents above October NYMEX futures. Low sulpher 55-grade weakened 0.50 cent to about 2.00 cents over heat.
Diffs in New York Harbor stayed steady at 4.50 cents over.
-- Franklin Paul, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1620
